square-rendering.options.title: Square Rendering
square-rendering.option.enabled.tooltip: Render chunks in a square around your current chunk, with square distance fog. A distance of 16 includes a 33 × 33 grid. This can increase GPU and memory usage. Singleplayer works automatically; full multiplayer corners require this same mod on the Fabric server. Applying reloads resources. Simulation distance is unchanged.
